labeling_rule: A record governs a PR when its ADR's decision constrains what the PR's changed lines may contain or how they are written (the decided choice, the component it chose, or the structure it mandates), judged by reading each hunk against the ADR text. Codebase-wide conventions (named exports, export structure, React.FC, MSW, Luxon, plugin package structure) count wherever the changed lines contain the construct (any added/changed `export` in a package src/ file counts for bs-adr003 + bs-adr004). Superseded/deprecated records never govern. Labels were written from the diffs and the ADR texts, never from the overlay anchors or Mole's output.
selection: govuk-infrastructure: of the 60 newest first-parent merges (head 879ee65c), the 9 whose paths fall under an ADR subject named in the ADR texts (cluster-*, github, tfc-*) + 6 other recent ones of different kinds; backstage: 8 merges from the subject paths of the ADR texts (catalog-model kinds/entity/schema, frontend-plugin-api blueprints, the ADR log; <=10 files each, fetched with --depth 2) + 7 recent merges of different kinds from the newest 30 (head e8c4d056). Overlay records (bench/m24/<repo>/.mole) were written from the ADR texts BEFORE the PR lists were read.
owners_rule: bench/m24_owners.py (GitHub's documented CODEOWNERS rules, CODEOWNERS read at the merge base, union over changed paths)

backstage.clone_cmd: git clone --no-checkout --depth 200 --single-branch <url>; git fetch --depth 2 origin <the 8 older merge shas>
